title: Telemetry-anchored rollback briefing canvas and time-scrubber flow
creator: Lina Matthews
description: Purpose: design a compact, operator-focused rollback briefing canvas that anchors a rollback decision to live telemetry, cost delta, and user impact signals. Context: teams using Redwood Dedicated and Hosted need fast, confident rollback actions during staged rollouts. Current console prototypes focus on authoring traffic splits but lack a focused, low-friction 'decide-and-act' surface that bundles signal, quick root-cause notes, and a reversible action model. This ticket covers a prototype for a time-scrubber + snapshot diff view that surfaces what changed in the last 30/60/300 minutes, shows cost delta per variant, and exposes a single-click 'surgical abort' with staged undo (snapshots + automatic notes).
acceptance_criteria: Interactive time-scrubber that rewinds rollout telemetry to selectable anchors (30m, 1h, 3h) and updates charts in under 300ms
Snapshot diff pane that highlights top 3 anomalous signals (error rate, median latency, cache miss-rate) and shows traffic percentage per variant
Cost delta indicator that estimates per-hour token spend change between current and previous variant mix
Primary action 'Surgical Abort' must require two-step confirmation and create an automatic changelog entry with justification text editable by the operator
Fallback strategy selector (auto-fallback to previous model / traffic drain / shadow-only) visible and editable from the canvas
Prototype flows annotated for engineering with implementation notes on telemetry sampling and API endpoints to fetch historical KV cache and batching stats

decisions: Prefer inline time-scrubber (compact row) over separate timeline panel to keep canvas single-pane for rapid action
Expose only top-3 anomalous signals by default; allow expanding to full signal list to reduce operator cognitive load
Two-step confirmation for Surgical Abort to avoid accidental rollbacks; second step requires quick justification text to seed incident notes
Show cost delta as per-hour estimate and cumulative 24h projection when traffic mix changes
Default fallback action is 'drain to previous model' for critical services, with ability to choose 'shadow-only' or 'full revert'
